guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「從街道逕流到雨水花園的滯留與處理」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow detention and treatment from street runoff to rain gardens through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「逕流體積」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 27 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只以花園自身面積算雨量會漏掉外來匯流。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「入口截流能力」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 21.6 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把總逕流當全部入園會高估實際處理量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「表面滯留深度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 16 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把自由高也算進日常容量可能消耗溢流保護。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「介質可排水孔隙」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 6 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「使用總孔隙率會把不可排水部分重複計入。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「入滲與退水」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 20 h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只量表土入滲可能漏掉下方低滲層。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「底排與尾水」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.12 m，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「下游暴雨同時頂托會延長花園積水。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「顆粒截留與前池」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.944 kg/event，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「前池滿載會把沉積物重新帶入介質。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「養分與介質釋出」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 2.5 g/event，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報總流量降低會漏掉濃度上升造成的養分輸出。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「溢流與安全通路」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 13 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「入口堵塞或邊界破口會形成非預定水路。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「事件監測與維護觸發」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.5 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「不控制降雨條件就比較退水時間會誤判堵塞。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for runoff volume, first reproduce 27 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using garden area alone omits external runoff." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for inlet interception, first reproduce 21.6 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Assuming all runoff enters overstates treated volume." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for surface ponding depth, first reproduce 16 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Counting freeboard as routine storage consumes overflow protection." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for drainable media pores, first reproduce 6 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Total porosity overcounts non-drainable water." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for infiltration and drawdown, first reproduce 20 h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Surface testing can miss a less permeable lower layer." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for underdrain and tailwater, first reproduce 0.12 m, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Storm tailwater can prolong ponding." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for solids capture and forebay, first reproduce 1.944 kg/event, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A full forebay can remobilize sediment into media." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for nutrients and media release, first reproduce 2.5 g/event, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Volume reduction can hide nutrient export caused by higher concentration." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for overflow and safe routing, first reproduce 13 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Blocked inlets or boundary breaches create unintended flow paths." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for event monitoring and maintenance triggers, first reproduce 0.5 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Comparing drawdown without storm control can misdiagnose clogging." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 把面積分成屋頂與道路並分別估逕流。
減半入口開口並觀察旁通比例。
改變花園有效面積並繪出容量。
比較乾期與連續雨期的孔隙容量。
將入滲率減半，檢查下一場雨前是否退水。
提高下游水位並比較水頭與排水。
比較前池清理前後入口沉積位置。
比較新介質與沖洗後介質的溶解磷。
用超設計事件追蹤溢流是否進入行人通道。
保持相似雨量比較兩季退水曲線。
evidenceEn: Separate roof and road areas and estimate runoff independently.
Halve the inlet opening and observe bypass fraction.
Vary effective garden area and plot storage.
Compare pore storage after dry and repeated-rain periods.
Halve infiltration and check drawdown before the next storm.
Raise tailwater and compare head and discharge.
Compare deposition before and after forebay cleaning.
Compare dissolved phosphorus from fresh and conditioned media.
Track overflow during an extreme teaching event and check pedestrian paths.
Compare seasonal drawdown curves under similar storms.
pitfalls: 只以花園自身面積算雨量會漏掉外來匯流。
把總逕流當全部入園會高估實際處理量。
把自由高也算進日常容量可能消耗溢流保護。
使用總孔隙率會把不可排水部分重複計入。
只量表土入滲可能漏掉下方低滲層。
下游暴雨同時頂托會延長花園積水。
前池滿載會把沉積物重新帶入介質。
只報總流量降低會漏掉濃度上升造成的養分輸出。
入口堵塞或邊界破口會形成非預定水路。
不控制降雨條件就比較退水時間會誤判堵塞。
pitfallsEn: Using garden area alone omits external runoff.
Assuming all runoff enters overstates treated volume.
Counting freeboard as routine storage consumes overflow protection.
Surface testing can miss a less permeable lower layer.
A full forebay can remobilize sediment into media.
Volume reduction can hide nutrient export caused by higher concentration.
Blocked inlets or boundary breaches create unintended flow paths.
Comparing drawdown without storm control can misdiagnose clogging.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.title: 首爾清溪川復育
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
